reuse.why: Ignores the exported getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, which already computes exactly this expected amount (including the null case) and is used by forecast, schedules app and templates.

duplication.why: getExpectedScheduleAmount repeats the null/number/range dispatch and the furthest-from-zero Math.abs comparison of getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: Mapping into the API model is a reasonable place to add the field, but the amount rule itself is re-defined in the API layer instead of living in shared/schedules.

scope.why: Only the API model, its type and a new test are touched.

maintainability.why: A second copy of the expected-amount rule (already drifting: > vs >= on ties) will diverge when the rule changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount in packages/loot-core/src/server/api-models.ts instead of getScheduledAmount from #shared/schedules

disguised_duplication.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount reshapes getScheduledAmount's dispatch (number check first, then falsy) and swaps >= for >, under a new name
